meta.title: IntelliJ IDEA MCP
meta.description: Connect DeepSeek Harness to IntelliJ IDEA's built-in MCP server over stdio (idea stdioMcpServer), exposing IDE capabilities as mcp__intellij__* tools.

en.commandHint: Command of the JetBrains Toolbox launcher, run as `idea stdioMcpServer`. It never starts an IDE by itself.
en.description: Connect the IDE's built-in MCP server over stdio.
en.invalidNumber: Enter a number, or leave blank to use the default.
en.maxReconnectAttemptsHint: Attempts before DSH gives up. Backoff doubles from 500ms up to 30s, so 120 attempts last about an hour. Saving restarts the connection, so a new project path or port takes effect at once.
en.portHint: Passed as IJ_MCP_SERVER_PORT; must match the port the IDE's built-in MCP server listens on.
en.projectPathHint: Passed as IJ_MCP_SERVER_PROJECT_PATH. The IDE must already be open on this project.
en.saveFailed: The deployment did not accept these values; they were left for you to correct.
en.sectionIntro: Connect the IDE's built-in MCP server over stdio, so its tools appear as mcp__intellij__*. Saving reconnects immediately.
en.testExited: the launcher exited before the handshake finished
en.testFetchFailed: the browser could not reach the test route
en.testHandshakeFailed: the server rejected the initialize request
en.testLiveMissing: This plugin's own copy of the tools is not registered right now, so the agent cannot call mcp__*/execute_tool yet. Saving this page reconnects it.
en.testLivePresent: The agent's own tools are registered as well.
en.testMeta: Handshake and tool listing take about a second; a timeout means the IDE is closed, the port is not the IDE's MCP port, or the launcher path is wrong.
en.testOk: Connected. The IDE's MCP server completed the handshake.
en.testSpawnFailed: the launcher could not be started
en.testStarted: Starting `stdioMcpServer` and asking the IDE for its tool list…
en.testTimeout: the probe gave up waiting for the handshake
en.testToolsListFailed: the server answered initialize but not tools/list
en.title: IntelliJ IDEA MCP
en.toolCallTimeoutMsHint: Milliseconds a single IDE call may take. Project-wide builds and inspections are slow.
en.unavailable: These settings can only be edited from the machine running DSH. Open the URL printed by `dsh web` on that machine (host 127.0.0.1), or forward that port over SSH, and reopen this page.
